notes: Launcher 3.19: PLAY starts the game the first time. Old log files from removed experimental add-ons no longer block PLAY; a game that is still running or stuck is detected and can be closed from the launcher; a second press while the game loads just says it is starting; a repair goes straight on to start the game. The game itself is unchanged.

addons.title: Smoke mines, spawn protection, frag blast, merc jump, flashbang sight and roll fix
